source: GET /_ping and GET /version on a rootless Podman 5.7.0 API socket (runc, netavark, pasta, cgroup v2), plus `podman info` and `podman network inspect` run against it; the socket path, build details and host names are scrubbed or left out.

gatewayInspect.note: the network definition names a bridge gateway; a rootless container on pasta does not use it, and its /etc/hosts maps host.docker.internal and host.containers.internal to the pasta address 169.254.1.2
